## 🎉 Welcome!

We're thrilled to announce the launch of the **BCN Babylab Network website**! This platform will serve as a hub for our research community, fostering collaboration and sharing knowledge about infant development and cognition.

## What You'll Find Here

📚 **Resources**: Access research materials, best practices, and methodological guides  
📅 **Events**: Stay updated with upcoming workshops, seminars, and network meetings  
🔗 **Collaboration**: Connect with researchers across Barcelona and beyond  
📖 **News**: Follow the latest developments in infant research  

## Getting Started

Whether you're an established researcher or just beginning your career in infant development, we welcome you to explore our site and consider joining our network.

### Quick Links

- **[Learn About Us](../about.qmd)** - Discover our mission and values

## Looking Forward

We're excited to build this community together and support rigorous, collaborative research on infant development. Stay tuned for announcements about upcoming events and initiatives!
